name: ui-popover-anchor
title: Popover Enter and Exit
description: Bấm nút, bảng nổi hiện ra và phóng từ 0.94 lên đủ cỡ quanh đúng góc gắn với nút; đóng thì thu lại về góc đó rồi biến mất.

moworks.author: moworks

options.closeAt: s after opening to close (1.4); 0.36 s ease-in, then hidden

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Anchor button (circle r12 with '…'). Popover 128x74 r10 whose bottom-left corner sits on the anchor point: opacity 0 → 1 and scale 0.94 → 1 about that corner over 0.4-0.92 s (520 ms) power2.out. Exit at 1.8 s: the reverse over 360 ms power2.in, then hidden (display none). Content: accent title bar + 3 lines. Cursor clicks at 0.3 s and 1.7 s. Params: anchor: góc neo · scale (0.94 → 1) · in (0.52 s, power2.out) · out (0.36 s, power2.in).
moworks.titleVi: Bảng nổi bung ra từ góc neo
